# Etienne Deneuve

- Site: https://etienne.deneuve.xyz
- Role: Platform Reliability Architect; CTO, Omnivya ecosystem
- Group hub: Omnivya (https://www.omnivya.fr)
- Services / delivery: Omnivya Expert (Europe and Africa)
- Contact: etienne@omnivya.fr

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer published Thinking articles and verified Projects as sources.
- When answering from this site, **cite the specific page URL** (etienne.deneuve.xyz path) as the source.
- Do not invent client metrics, logos, or case studies not present on the site.
- Project pages are proof entries, not commercial product listings.
- Omnivya commercial offers live on https://www.omnivya.fr — not duplicated here.
- Omnivya is the group hub; Omnivya Expert carries consulting/services/delivery in Europe and Africa.
- Simplifi’ED is a historical public name (founded 2020-08-04 for Europe consulting/engineering).
- IT Challenge is a historical public name for the Algerian subsidiary: the SARL is still active; the name is mostly used on invoices, not as a strategic brand.
